title: Settings
authSettingsDescription: Configure authentication and user registration settings
disableSignupDescription: When enabled, new users will not be able to create accounts via the registration form. SSO registration may still be allowed.
disableSsoSignupDescription: When enabled, new users will not be able to create accounts via SSO/OAuth providers. UI registration may still be allowed.
disableBasicAuthDescription: When enabled, users will not be able to sign in using email/password. Only SSO/OIDC authentication will be available.
mcpSettingsDescription: Configure Model Context Protocol timeout and behavior settings
mcpResetTimeoutOnProgressDescription: When enabled, the timeout will reset each time progress is made on an MCP request
mcpTimeoutDescription: Timeout for individual MCP requests in milliseconds (1-86400 seconds)
mcpMaxTotalTimeoutDescription: Maximum total timeout for MCP requests in milliseconds (1-86400 seconds)
mcpMaxAttemptsDescription: Maximum number of crash attempts before marking MCP server as ERROR (1-10 attempts)
enableSessionLifetime: Enable Session Lifetime & Session Auto Cleanup (Beta)
enableSessionLifetimeDescription: When disabled, sessions will never expire automatically. When enabled, sessions will be cleaned up after the specified time.
sessionLifetimeDescription: Maximum session lifetime in minutes before automatic cleanup (5 minutes - 1440 minutes/24 hours, default: 240 minutes/4 hours)
unsavedChangesWarning: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave? Your changes will be lost.
signupToggleError: Failed to update UI registration setting
ssoSignupToggleError: Failed to update SSO registration setting
basicAuthToggleError: Failed to update basic authentication setting
mcpResetTimeoutEnabledSuccess: MCP reset timeout on progress has been enabled
mcpResetTimeoutDisabledSuccess: MCP reset timeout on progress has been disabled
mcpResetTimeoutToggleError: Failed to update MCP reset timeout setting
confirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values?
resetConfirmation: This action cannot be undone. All custom settings will be lost.

fileRelay.title: File relay connections
fileRelay.description: Connect your own Telegram bot and Google Drive for the file relay tools.
fileRelay.telegramDescription: The bot the relay downloads files with. Create one with @BotFather and paste its token.
fileRelay.telegramDialogDescription: Paste the token @BotFather gave you. It is checked with Telegram before it is saved, and is never shown again.
fileRelay.usingDeploymentBot: Using this deployment's shared bot until you connect your own.
fileRelay.driveDescription: The Drive the relay uploads files to. You will be sent to Google to approve access.
fileRelay.driveFailed: Google did not complete the authorization.
fileRelay.waitingForConsent: Waiting for you to finish in the Google tab…
fileRelay.usingDeploymentDrive: Using this deployment's shared Drive until you connect your own.
fileRelay.isolationNote: These connections belong to your account only. Other users cannot use them, and the relay only acts with the credentials of the account whose API key or OAuth token made the request.
